$comment: Historic map overlays. Two kinds are supported: (1) 'image' — a public-domain or licensed image placed with ArcGIS MediaLayer using control points or corner coordinates (put the file in public/maps/); (2) 'service' — a WMS, WMTS, ArcGIS MapServer/ImageServer or XYZ tile template served by a third party. Nothing is bundled whose licence was not confirmed. The 'illustrative-plan-1791' entry is generated from this project's own schematic data so the overlay controls can be demonstrated; it is NOT a historic map.
